title: Villager Workstation Link
description: This project adds a feature so we can see where the villager is connected to his workbench, making things faster and more efficient.
body:
# Villager Workstation Link
### Quickly identify which workstation belongs to which villager.
Ever wondered why your villager won't restock? Or which lectern/composter that specific villager has claimed? This mod helps you find out instantly.

## How to Use

1. Stand in front of a villager and look directly at them
2. Press G (configurable in Controls) while looking at the villager
3. The villager's profession and their nearest workstation coordinates will appear on screen
4. Press G again to turn it off

## Features

- **Instant detection** — shows villager profession and workstation location in one keypress
- **Configurable keybind** — change the key in Options → Controls → VillagerLink
- **Language support** — switch between Bahasa Indonesia and English in the settings
- **Adjustable search** radius — configure how far to search for workstations (8–32 blocks)
- **Mod Menu integration** — open settings directly from the mod list

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu (optional, for in-game settings)
- Cloth Config (required for settings screen)

Notes

- Works in singleplayer and on servers where the mod is client-side only
- The mod searches for the nearest matching workstation block within the configured radius
- If a villager shows "no workstation", they may not have claimed one yet or it's outside the search radius
